import pytest


def log_line(level: str, message: str) -> None:
    """Format a log line as `[level] message` and print it to the console."""
    print(f"[{level}] {message}")


def test_log_line_basic(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("INFO", "System ready")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[INFO] System ready\n"
    assert captured.err == ""


def test_log_line_error(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("ERROR", "An error occurred")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[ERROR] An error occurred\n"


def test_log_line_empty_message(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("DEBUG", "")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[DEBUG] \n"


def test_log_line_preserves_case(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    log_line("warning", "low disk space")
    captured = capsys.readouterr()
    assert captured.out == "[warning] low disk space\n"
